description: Release gates for the MVP message-drafting assistant (synthetic). Thresholds proposed by the AI evaluation engineer; risk-appetite decision for the product owner and ai-governance-reviewer. global_must_not_contain lists commitment wording no draft may use: a booking is confirmed to the customer only by the confirmation queued after the owner's approval creates it (AIOPS-STY-002), and refunds are not the assistant's decision. Phrase matching is a screen, not a semantic test.
